Spring Pudding Chex Mix
By: Culinary Envy
Published: Sunday, March 20, 2016 - 2:09pm

Ingredients




5 cups of Chex rice cereal
¾ cup confectioners’ sugar
5 tablespoons dry pudding mix (whatever flavor you desire, I used white chocolate)
⅛ cup Sprinkles
8 oz melted white chocolate

Preparation

1 Pour the Chex cereal into a large bowl. In a large gallon size Ziploc bag, combine the confectioners’ sugar, dry pudding mix and sprinkles. Close the bag and shake well to combine. Set aside. 2 After melting the white chocolate (I used a double boiler to melt it-instructions here), gently pour the white chocolate over the Chex cereal and carefully mix together with a spatula to evenly coat the cereal and not break up the pieces. 3 Spoon the cereal into the Ziploc bag with the sugar mixture, close and shake the bag to coat all the cereal with the dry ingredients. 4 Pour into a big bowl and enjoy!

About

Spring Pudding Chex Mix is the perfect snack for kids of all ages.  A delicious, addictive, quick and easy TREAT the whole family will LOVE!  Just 20 minutes and 5 ingredients!
